title: Feature
description: Schema for a compendium Feature entry (Rpg/Compendium/Features/Feature.cs). The compendium file should be a JSON object whose keys are feature IDs.

CommonFields.description: Fields shared by all feature types.

DoesGetAttackedBlock.description: Overrides whether an entity with this feature can be attacked.

reason.description: Reason shown when the attack is blocked.

DoesAttackBlock.description: Overrides whether this entity can perform an attack.

reason.description: Reason shown when the attack is blocked.

DoesExecuteSkillBlock.description: Overrides whether this entity can execute a skill.

reason.description: Reason shown when skill execution is blocked.

type.description: Feature subtype. Determines which class is instantiated.

damage_type.description: [damage_over_time only] Name of the DamageType applied each interval.

damage.description: [damage_over_time only] Damage amount applied per interval.

interval.description: [damage_over_time only] Tick interval between damage applications.

doesGetAttacked.description: [arbitrary] Override for whether the entity can be attacked. 'reason' shown on block.

doesAttack.description: [arbitrary] Override for whether this entity can attack. 'reason' shown on block.

doesExecuteSkill.description: [arbitrary] Override for whether this entity can execute skills. 'reason' shown on block.

receivingDamage.description: [arbitrary] Modifier applied to damage received by this entity.

attackingDamage.description: [arbitrary] Modifier applied to damage dealt by this entity.

skills.description: [arbitrary] Skill compendium IDs granted by this feature.
